items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Turns Wellness Boutiques Into A Bigger Beauty Aisle Fight
items.summary: Ulta Beauty (NasdaqGS:ULTA) is ramping up wellness-focused shop-in-shop concepts as beauty and self-care gain shelf space in big-box retail. Walmart is expanding its own beauty and wellness aisles with more premium brands, putting direct pressure on Ulta Beauty's core category mix. Retail partners and suppliers are increasingly treating wellness as a separate growth pillar, reshaping how Ulta Beauty positions its boutiques versus mass retailers. items.title: Walmart (WMT) Tests AI Shopping In India Through Its Flipkart Business
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) is part of a new Google pilot that lets Indian shoppers buy from Flipkart using Gemini and AI Mode. The test allows Flipkart products to be discovered and purchased directly inside Google’s AI experiences for users in India. The program targets online buyers in India as the festive shopping season approaches, a period when e-commerce activity typically climbs.
